parsed.rationale: Both participating records are sample-app or demo-harness entry points, not production library code. The file path 'Shared/WXUI/Examples/WXUISampleApp/Sources/WXUISampleApp.swift' sits under the 'Examples/' directory, which is an explicit restraint-marker location per the decision rules. 'Shared/PlayerHeaderView/PlayerHeaderViewApp/PlayerHeaderViewApp.swift' is likewise a standalone app harness for the PlayerHeaderView package. The duplicated symbol is the SwiftUI 'App.body' computed property — unavoidable boilerplate required by the SwiftUI app lifecycle on every app target — so structural identity here is coincidental and load-bearing for each target independently. Merging or extracting these entry points would couple two unrelated demo targets and is not warranted.
